minecraft:written_book_content.author: UMBRA // Internal
pages:
RE: Anomaly 7C-"Thorne"
STATUS: Re-contained. Frame integrity nominal.

Field Investigator performance exceeded projections. The asset was reconstructed and re-sealed without organizational exposure. Commendable.

Note for the Investigator, off the record:

You did the right thing. He was not a man anymore. He was a hole shaped like one. The Frame is where holes like that belong.
We are extending you a permanent contract. There are other Frames. Other fractures. Thorne was one break in something far larger, and that larger thing has a name we do not write down.

It noticed you down there. It notices everyone who gets close. We will be in touch about what comes next.

— KEEP THIS QUIET —
DIRECTOR CHEN

[A second page is paperclipped behind the first in different handwriting.]

He said your name at the end. Before the Frame sealed. I did not tell Chen that part.

— E.V.
